name: Gorgias
description: Support and helpdesk: ecommerce-focused helpdesk (tickets, customers, macros, rules) with deep Shopify/BigCommerce/Magento integrations.
access_notes: 7-day free trial, no credit card. REST API credentials (email + API key) are self-serve from Settings -> REST API and available on all Helpdesk plans; OAuth2 is mandatory for public apps. Vendor MCP requires a paid plan.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP at https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp (OAuth, open beta, included in paid plans). Composio GORGIAS toolkit exists (32 tools, Composio-managed auth with api_key and oauth2 options).
uncertainty_notes: Private-app API key is used as the password in HTTP Basic auth (email:api_key base64-encoded), so basic_auth and api_key describe the same mechanism. Webhooks are delivered via the 'HTTP Integrations' feature rather than a dedicated webhooks product.

evidence.note: Two auth methods: private app -> API key (HTTP Basic with email:api_key), public app -> OAuth2 (mandatory for public apps).
API keys 'available on all Helpdesk plans'; admins create keys self-serve under Settings -> REST API.
HTTP Integrations fire on ticket events (created/updated/message created etc.) with retries — Gorgias's webhook mechanism.
Official Gorgias MCP server at https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp, OAuth login with Gorgias account.
Composio Gorgias toolkit: 32 tools, Composio-managed auth.
